title: Module overlay
description: What Danbyte adds to one upstream NetBox module type, in `danbyte/module-overlays/<Vendor>/<model>.yaml`. It names its upstream file and adds or patches only what Danbyte needs: Danbyte keys (`model3d`, `meta`), NetBox top-level keys that need correcting, and component lists patched by name with `add:` / `remove:` entries that each say `why`. The merge (`danbyte-lib preview`) is what Danbyte imports; upstream fixes flow in untouched, and `sync-check` reports patched names that upstream no longer has.

upstream.description: The NetBox YAML this overlay adds to, relative to the repository root: an upstream file under `module-types/`, or a Danbyte-only base under `danbyte/types-new/module-types/` for hardware upstream doesn't have yet. Never edited by the overlay.

part_number.description: NetBox key, overriding upstream: The vendor part number, when upstream's is wrong.
